items.title: Dark Mode Toggles: Two States are Enough
items.blurb: Yes, the underlying model must have three states, but one is always irrelevant to the actual user goal. Users do not seek out solutions to problems they don’t currently have.

items.title: Your SPA is Leaking Memory: 'Soak Test' It
items.blurb: Some teams force-reload their single-page web apps (SPAs) every few hours just to clear the memory the app leaked. A frontend soak test finds the leak instead.
